Name: Easy Crane Game
Author: Dragoon23
Description:
[size=4][b]Easy Crane Game. [/b][/size][size=3]

[b]Options. Everything can be turned on/off in the config file:[/b]

[/size][list]
[*][size=3]Infinite Tries/Credits. [/size]
[/list]
[list]
[*][size=3]Stop Timer.[/size]
[/list]
[list]
[*][size=3]Stop Conveyor Belt. [/size]
[/list]
[list]
[*][size=3]Prizes Never drop from Claw. [/size]
[/list]
[list]
[*][size=3]Removed Foliage that's blocking possible extra rewards. Rewards only spawn in the lower left and upper right hand corners of the plants. [/size]
[/list][size=3]
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]Move the prizes out of the foliage and into the conveyor belt rectangle. See screenshot for location.[/size]
[/list]
[list]
[*][size=3]Change drop rate for the Prizes to drop. Vanilla is 10% for 1st prize to spawn, and if that doesn't spawn, a 25% chance for the 2nd prize to spawn. If 1st prize is set to 100%, the 2nd prize will not spawn.[/size]
[/list]
[list]
[*][size=3]Allow both prizes to spawn at drop rate set.[/size]
[/list]
[size=3]
[b]Tips:
[/b][/size][list]
[*][size=3][b]For the lower left foliage prize, try positioning the top of the claw a little higher than the crate lid. See last screenshot for rough location. [/b][/size]
[/list]

[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][size=3][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].[/size]
[*][size=3]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].[/size]
[*][size=3]Run the game using SMAPI.[/size]
[/list]

[size=5]How to use[/size]
[size=3]Config file is generated into the mod folder after first launch. It's named config.json. Default is everything on. [/size]


[size=5]Compatibility[/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]Works with Stardew Valley 1.6 on Windows.[/size]
[*][size=3]Works in single player.[/size]
[*][size=3]Should be compatible with Linux/Mac/Multiplayer but I only test for Windows/single player so can't say for sure.[/size]
[/list][size=3]

[b]ChangeLog:[/b]
[/size][list]
[*][size=3][size=3]11/08/2024: Updated for 1.6.9+. Added option to have both prizes drop, move the prizes out of the foliage, and change drop rate of prizes.[/size][/size]
[*][size=3][size=3]04/15/2024: Removed Foliage blocking the possible prizes.[/size][/size]
[*][size=3][size=3]04/14/2024: Improved code, added stop time/conveyor Belt, changed display to be 9/99 for Infinite Tries/Stop Time respectively.[/size][/size]
[*][size=3]04/13/2024: Initial Release[/size]
[/list]
